name: Design Goals
summary: ● Brutal but heroic. ● Tactical without becoming simulation-heavy. ● Grimdark without making player choices meaningless. ● Built around ranged combat, cover, faith, corruption and dangerous psychic power. ● Playable with mixed warbands of soldiers, zealots, psykers, abhumans, enforcers, scum and Mechanicus operatives. ● Fast enough to run at a normal tabletop while still making equipment and battlefield position matter.
